part.name: Hook-ended clevis linkage lever
part.description: Single-piece elongated mechanical lever with a forked, coaxially bored clevis at one end, a tapered load-carrying arm, and an open hook or cradle at the opposite end. The exact application is uncertain, but the geometry is consistent with a pivoted linkage or latch lever that receives a pin at the clevis and engages another member at the hook.
part.symmetry_note: The part is substantially mirror-symmetric about the CAD y=0 plane. The two clevis ears form a paired mirrored structure, and most of the arm and hook geometry is centered on that plane. No circular or high-count periodic pattern is present.

semantic_orientation.description: The clevis is interpreted as the rear pivot end and the open hook as the front engagement end. CAD +Z is interpreted as the upper broad side and CAD -Z as the lower broad side. Left and right across the lever width are assigned from the inferred forward-facing convention but remain less certain than the front/back and top/bottom assignments.
